title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
objectives: Develop and validate unsteady flamelet generated manifold (UFGM) models for concurrent flame spread in microgravity, using BASS data to improve predictions of material flammability limits.
approach: Couple fluid/solid combustion simulations with unsteady flamelet-generated chemistry models. Use geometries from BASS/BASS-II (sheets, spheres, PMMA rods, and wax cylinders) and apply two-color tomography to archived flame imagery to compare predicted geometry, soot, temperature, and spread rates.
status_message: No data available for this investigation yet. Graphs cannot be generated.
